# Five-day forecast

Re-measured 2026-11-04 on modules ea824356: sdn-ap 0.5.1 (d29acd2b5d92), sgp4-xp 0.2.1 (816fd137d761) (FIVE-DAY.md, amendment of 2026-11-04): AP, XP and S re-fitted and re-flown as one $OCM on the archived inputs, U re-fitted on sgp4-xp 0.2.1; F and the GP products are the registered rows. Old leads are compared with the stored rows of each arm's build: AP, XP and U with that build's AP5 and AP6 re-measure (operator-theory, 2026-11-04), S and F with AP 0.4.0's store.

Five-day answer. A pair class can show a Pc at day 5 when its zero-miss ceiling reaches 1e-4 in at least half of a group's windows, for at least one registered fit arc (GP age bin [5,7] d); the 1e-5 fractions, every arc and every arm are in the CA-reach table. With a GP covariance (fit x GP or GP x GP), P and T never reach 1e-4 in most windows, for any arm or any hard-body radius up to 100 m. At 10 m: fit x fit, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, IG, LS, S1 and in some but under half for HE, HX, P, T; relative to XP, AP adds HX, P, T; F adds HX, P, T; S drops DO, GE, GN, IG, S1; U drops S1. fit x GP, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for GD, GN, LS and in some but under half for DO; relative to XP, F adds DO; S drops GN. GP x GP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for no group and in some but under half for DO, GD, LS (a GP covariance on both objects, the same for every arm; median ceilings span 1.7e-10 (P) to 8.1e-5 (LS)). At 20 m: fit x fit, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, IG, LS, S1 and in some but under half for HE, HX, P, T; relative to XP, AP adds HX, P, T; F adds HX, P, T; S drops GE, IG. fit x GP, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GN, LS, S1 and in some but under half for no group; relative to XP, no arm changes this. GP x GP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GN, LS, S1 and in some but under half for no group (a GP covariance on both objects, the same for every arm; median ceilings span 6.7e-10 (P) to 3.2e-4 (LS)). At 50 m: fit x fit, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, HE, IG, LS, P, S1 and in some but under half for HX, T; relative to XP, AP adds HX, T; F adds HX, T; S drops GE, HE, IG; U drops HE. fit x GP, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, IG, LS, S1 and in some but under half for no group; relative to XP, S drops GE, IG. GP x GP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, IG, LS, S1 and in some but under half for no group (a GP covariance on both objects, the same for every arm; median ceilings span 4.2e-9 (P) to 2.0e-3 (LS)). At 100 m: fit x fit, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, HE, HX, IG, LS, P, S1, T and in some but under half for no group; relative to XP, S drops HE, HX; U drops HE. fit x GP, with XP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, HE, HX, IG, LS, S1 and in some but under half for no group; relative to XP, S drops HE, HX; U drops HE. GP x GP, 1e-4 is reached in most windows for DO, GD, GE, GN, IG, LS, S1 and in some but under half for no group (a GP covariance on both objects, the same for every arm; median ceilings span 1.7e-8 (P) to 8.0e-3 (LS)). Every finite nonsingular covariance has positive zero-miss Pc, so these are threshold-reach results, not alert rates. A fit's sigma here is its own window's realized R/T error, not a forecast covariance. Unfinished runs are not evidence of zero reach. The synthetic encounter rates below describe an artificial population and cannot establish operational five-day CA rates.

Forecast coverage: 33/33 group/phase cells complete. Old-lead reproduction: 398392 scalar comparisons, 0 differences, maximum 0 km. Incomplete runs do not support a group conclusion.

Arms: AP is the operator-theory propagator, XP is the whiteroom XP fit, U is Space Force XP, S is the SGP4 fit, F is FFM, and GP is a public SGP4 set; the hours of the fit arc follow the arm name. Groups: P and T are strong-drag low orbit (Swarm and GRACE-FO; T is the 944 windows of 2025 in AP.md), S1 is Sentinel-1A and 1C, GN is GPS, Galileo and GLONASS in medium Earth orbit, LS laser spheres, DO altimetry satellites, GD laser geodetic satellites above 5,000 km, IG inclined geosynchronous, GE geostationary, HE TESS, HX THEMIS and Chandra. AP and XP fits and forecast states use sdn-ap 0.5.1, which ships the AP 0.4.1 process-noise table unchanged (the synthetic covariance is labeled UNVERIFIED), and U uses sgp4-xp 0.2.1, both at the pinned build of operator-theory (lib/build.mjs PIN); the frozen builds and hashes of the other arms are in experiments/five-day-ca/config.json, builds.json and covariance-config.json.

LS and DO day-4/day-5 rows are descriptive: read before the statements were registered. FIVE-DAY.md also discloses earlier partial rows in other groups. Subsequent registration does not turn those rows into prospective evidence. All paired results include these disclosed reads; they are descriptive pending separate provenance accounting. Only aggregates are redistributed.

Every expected arm/arc/day cell, including missing work and counted exclusion reasons, is in metrics.json armDayCoverage. A missing run is not a scientific exclusion. Summaries weight windows equally; R/T/N RMS is the square root of the mean squared window axis RMS. Intervals resample ISO weeks 10,000 times.

Six-day replay: 240 scalars, 0 differences, maximum 0 m, 0 rejected. U accepts at most 1 m per scalar because of the library's query-order dependence (experiments/propagator-ca-frontier/PLAN.md, Amendment A1); AP, XP, S and F require exact equality.

Synthetic fit x fit and fit x GP pairs (GP primary is the repeated GP x GP reference): AP 0.4.1 shipped table UNVERIFIED, XP C2 fairness, FFM C3-small R2/R3 and C2 elsewhere, S RMS STAND-IN, GP age-bin error model. Frozen class constants are transferred to these groups and seven-day leads as documented in COVARIANCE.md. All errors and completed covariances are in common truth RTN axes, rotated by gp-error-model after C2/C3 scaling. Same primary, secondary, angle and miss draws across arms. True miss is log-uniform 10 m–5 km, HBR 20 m, alert at Pc >=1e-4. Missing products and numerical failures are counted, never assigned zero Pc. GP covariance uses actual age since the selected set epoch; ages beyond seven days are outside the frozen model and are excluded. Product coverage: 3156/3156 fitted windows and 3156/3156 GP windows. Complete: true.
